Reanalysis of the same data: the authors state 'We proceed by re-examining the microcensus dataset used by RA (2014)' and rerun Rostam-Afschar's (2014, Empir Econ 47:1067-1101) difference-in-differences regressions on the same German Microcensus survey after re-coding which occupations count as crafts trades (Sect. 4, Appendix A), so no new participants or new data test the original claims. Ambiguous: the paper also runs a DiD on aggregate ZDH company-registry exit counts (Table 6) as a cross-check, which a second coder might count as a conceptual replication of RA's null exit claim (it finds an increase); the authors frame the ZDH data as motivation and a cross-check, not as the replication.
